sources_considered.why: The latest version (v3, September 2025) reports the best agent completing 30% of tasks.
OpenAI describes its 2025 agent as early-stage and error-prone, while also reporting some near-human results.

evidence_items.publisher: arXiv (Xu et al., Carnegie Mellon University)

receipt.public_excerpt: find that the most competitive agent can complete 30% of tasks autonomously.

evidence_items.explanation: By September 2025 the best agent still completed only 30% of the workplace tasks. This shows modest progress, but it says nothing about whether commonsense progress happened.

receipt.public_excerpt: ChatGPT agent is still in its early stages. It’s capable of taking on a range of complex tasks, but it can still make mistakes.

evidence_items.explanation: The vendor itself describes its mid-2025 agent as early-stage and error-prone. This is context on 'working well'.

unresolved_gaps: There is no agreed measure of whether 'major progress in common sense' has occurred.
There is no agreed threshold for agents 'working well'.
There is no deadline, so continued shortfalls do not settle the claim either.
